param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**sentieon_dedup**
Runs the sentieon tool LocusCollector followed by Dedup. LocusCollector collects read information that is used by Dedup which in turn marks or removes duplicate reads.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: sentieon/dedup - Container: biocontainers/sentieon:202503.01
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
